what: A separately versioned, portable regeneration of the 83 PINK instruments sealed in mapping-phase-{e,f,g}-contract. The historical seal is unchanged; this layer is additive.
ownerDecision: Integrate PINK's portability repair over a new, separately versioned evidence layer. Keep all 167 historical seal entries unchanged.

resolver.whyNotCopied: pink-tools.mjs derives REPO_ROOT five levels up from its own directory. A copy at <layer>/mapping-phase-pink-tools/ is one level too deep, derives REPO_ROOT=<repo>/docs, finds no .git and THROWS AT IMPORT by its own guard. Measured, not reasoned. One canonical copy also cannot drift.

historicalSeal.note: These three manifests must be byte-identical before and after generation. Their digests are recorded here so a reader can detect a later change without consulting git.

a_g499_clause: A checksum answers 'is this venue internally consistent?' and never 'does it describe the build it claims to'. This layer's own manifest.sha256 is therefore NOT evidence of provenance — it would verify perfectly against any content generated at the same time. The per-instrument triple below is the provenance evidence: manifest digest, recomputed digest, output digest. Generation REFUSES if any recomputed source digest differs from its historical manifest line.
refusalRule: If any of the 83 recomputed source digests differs from its manifest line, NO output file is written and the generator exits 4. Checked for all 83 before the first write.
